Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.v1.generated.model

Record Class Problem

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.v1.generated.model.Problem
Record Components:
type - URI reference identifying the problem type, a URN such as urn:problem:documents:not-found.
title - Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.
status - HTTP status code of the answer.
detail - Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. It never carries a token.
instance - URI reference identifying this occurrence, usually the request path.
acrValues - Only in a urn:problem:documents:step-up-required problem: the space-separated authentication context class references the resource server asks for, to pass as acrValues to GET /bff/login. Absent when the resource server named none.
maxAge - Only in a urn:problem:documents:step-up-required problem: the maximum age, in seconds, of the authentication the resource server accepts, to pass as maxAge to GET /bff/login. Absent when the resource server named none.
@Generated(value="org.openapitools.codegen.languages.SpringCodegen", date="2026-11-09T18:05:30.745318294Z[Etc/UTC]", comments="Generator version: 7.27.0") public record Problem(@Valid URI type, String title, Integer status, String detail, @Valid URI instance, String acrValues, Long maxAge) extends Record
RFC 9457 problem details of a failed call to the documents, answered as application/problem+json. The operations also declare them under application/json so that a client that only asks for JSON is not refused with 406: it gets the status and the problem (still as application/problem+json).
